blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-19. EVM deployments run the verified Spiko Token implementation (identical 6,009-byte Token.sol core across 0x15ea0ec460a0e6847ec0aa8d50a84b3a51b95f74 and 0x13ae01cbce8530012516fbc1273803d4995aee71). Token._update requires PermissionManager.canCall(from/to, token, 0xa9059cbb) for both parties (zero side exempt for mint/burn), so revoking a holder's group freezes that holder's transfers. The implementation also exposes restricted pause(), restricted burn(address,uint256) from an arbitrary holder, and restricted UUPS upgrade. At Arbitrum block 516204261 (2026-10-19T06:17:20Z), authority 0xa925C217e4c1C82Ee721eBD496d3863D5C2d829A (proxy to PermissionManager 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472) returned getRequirements(token,0xa9059cbb)=65 and a whitelisted-holder-to-0x...0001 transfer reverted with UnauthorizedTo(address,address) 0xb77a4ad1; group 0 is held by 3/3 Safe 0x7843225ba488cf780a4fe2c842b5dc2abcf8a03e. Polygon authority 0x344278... (group-0 3/3 Safe 0xa4196f06fe948b8ca81d3dc77110d3f83d10abd9) and Ethereum authority 0x344278... (group-0 3/3 Safe 0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea) enforce the same requirement at blocks 95790196 (2026-10-19T06:17:21Z) and 26224761 (2026-10-19T06:14:23Z). At Soroban ledger 65021030 (2026-10-19T06:22:13Z) has_role returned WLISTER Some(0) for GD2ELXTHZQORSH75SJE6XRTCKXNDGJFIZ4R2SZ4MMXDOBT52GK26X4EO and Some(1) for GAUYO4UAESQD6SGZDPOIG2ADT7EZTR5EJ7HSX4CYCWS2JMMGQOCL4QCX, BURNER Some(0) for CAVZK26ERVGKGXLQGEOKPAQGIZS2YKN4BSXOYDMUY365EV66ZNSFEDBS; role_revoked|WLISTED is present in the permission-manager history. oracleRisk.summary: The issuer's current NAV directory identifies Ethereum RedStone feed 0x4b2c406f0dbf7624a32971277da7b4c43a7a942b for exact EURSPKCC. It authenticates three distinct signatures from five authorized RedStone signers for eurSPKCC_NAV; authorized relayers, including the manual updater, cannot bypass signature validation. Round 902 returns 1.002215 EUR at 2026-10-20T17:53:23Z with eight decimals. This establishes standard external NAV publication, not a live market-price liquidation feed, independent underlying fund valuation, immutable upgrades or robust failover. CACEIS fund accounting, daily NAV timing and legacy issuer-operated feeds remain distinct limitations.

branchApplicability.rationale: EURSPKCC represents shares in one professionally managed cash-and-carry fund. Investors do not open borrower-specific collateral positions, and the reviewed contracts expose no permissionless liquidation markets to split into branches. However, Spiko's permissioned Oracle publishes the fund share's euro-denominated NAV and the operator executes redemptions by burning shares, so that administrative NAV is a price-sensitive top-level valuation and redemption authority that must be scored.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EURSPKCC has eight issuer-native registers in the current exact share-class API; the previously reviewed Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Starknet and Stellar evidence retains its original dates. Etherlink and Solana native share identities were independently corroborated on 2026-10-20, without certifying their complete operator, upgrade or transport inventory. The previously observed Chainlink CCIP pools span the four originally reviewed EVM native deployments with twelve directed lanes, using BurnWithFromMintTokenPool 1.6.1 conserved burn-and-mint. Those pools are administered by EOA 0xEd608cf38968C0ba09676843D90B33Dd59dd7375, which can update peers and rate-limit configuration; these are bridge-route powers, separate from native issuance. No new CCIP participation, material supply share or immutable bridge bound is inferred for Etherlink or Solana.
